title: Using a MIP Solver as a PDHG-Based MIP Heuristic
summary: The PDHG algorithm provides a new capability for solving difficult linear programming (LP) problems: the ability to find low-accuracy solutions quickly. While such solutions may not be applicable in all applications of LP, one possible use is to accelerate heuristics for finding feasible solutions to Mixed-Integer Programming (MIP) problems, where these approximate LP solutions can hopefully guide a heuristic towards accurate and high-quality MIP solutions.
